name: Cronus Fragt ruleset
description: Code analysis rules for Cronus Fragt. The test project has its own copy (cronusfragt.ruleset.json in test/) with the same content.

rules.justification: Every field and action that users see needs a tooltip, so a missing tooltip stops the build.
Mette wants tooltips written as 'Specifies ...'; a wrong start of a tooltip stops the build.

internalsVisibleTo only opens internals to Cronus Fragt Tests (id 31e3580c-855a-4f98-a6f4-3627af1be009). Access modifiers are not a security boundary here: the CRF Freight permission set protects the data, and the test app is never installed in production.

The project does not use namespaces: all objects carry the CRF affix, which already isolates them, and the extension is installed for Cronus only. Moving everything into a namespace is a rename of every object reference and has to be done together with the AppSource decision (step 35).
